label: 07-qa01-retry
workflow: Gemini CLI with Tessl MCP and vendored plugin context
submission_method: complete multiline plain prompt via direct Node entrypoint

disable_evidence.method: Read-only embedded JavaScript inspection of the exact SHA-pinned executable
disable_evidence.interpretation: Interval zero disables automatic binary replacement, rather than checking on every invocation. TESSL_DISABLE_UPDATE=1 additionally disables update actions. This does not assert that telemetry or latest-version lookup is disabled.

tessl_runtime.rationale: Direct versioned executable matches the final installed Stage 1 Tessl runtime; NPM bootstrap version is recorded separately and is not executed.
